verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API and an OpenAPI schema for retrieving transactions, cards, users and invoices, plus a guide on pulling transactions for reconciliation. These are developer building blocks a user would code against to build an export. There is no documented first-party bulk 'export all data' feature, open-format download, or account-exit/portability capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
